environment.description: EC2 instance (c5.xlarge) running Amazon Linux 2, hosting the legacy monolith as a single process with the internal HTTP API bound to 0.0.0.0:8080. The instance is in a VPC subnet with a permissive security group (ingress 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080). No service mesh sidecar is deployed. Any pod or service in the Kubernetes cluster (or any host with network access) can reach the /internal/sessions/invalidate endpoint directly, allowing an attacker to trigger rapid concurrent invalidation requests to exploit the race condition and cause a double-free, leading to heap corruption and potential RCE.

config.binary_hardening: no ASAN, no jemalloc, default glibc allocator
